# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately. Do not open a public issue.

You can report a vulnerability by submitting the advisory form here:
[https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents/security/advisories/new](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents/security/advisories/new)

If the form is not available or you are unable to use it, please contact the maintainer directly via their public GitHub profile:
[https://github.com/msitarzewski](https://github.com/msitarzewski)
